{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|A Hutt's Class Five is an Iotran's Class One.|Spacer saying, as related by Platt Okeefe|<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Penal References''', or '''ImPeRe''', were a set of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] infractions for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. There were five classes of ImPeRe infractions, ranking from Class Five to Class One in severity, though differences in enforcement by customs officials meant the infractions could be unevenly applied.<ref name="TEA" /> They also had a subsection detailing infractions related to droids, known as the [[Droid Statutes]].<ref name="CFT:D">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>

==Classes==
*'''Class Fives''', known as Quints, were usually for violating local import-export laws or lacking emergency equipment. Quints would receive a fine typically between 500 and 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but that could easily be paid off by slipping a local officer a "personal benefit fee."<ref name="TEA" /> If violators were found to be in conjunction with the Rebel Alliance, then long-term imprisonment is the sentence.<ref name="GG6">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>

*'''Class Fours''', or Quads, were for expired licenses, minor tax evasion, or transporting common narcotics without a permit, however the penalty could be worse for spice jockeys if they ran into the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] would only consider a spacer a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] once they acquired their first Quad. A typical fine for this offense was between 1000 and 5000 credits.<ref name="TEA" />

*'''Class Threes''', or Trips,<ref name="TEA" /> were for attempted bribery of Imperial or other officials, or illegal transport of higher-priced goods, high technology, and restricted items.<ref name="GG6" /> Trips were harder to remove unless one was outside the eyes of the Empire, where a carefully applied bribe could succeed (except, of course, in cases of attempted bribery).<ref name="TEA" /> Any ship transporting illegal goods was impounded and the captain arrested and taken to the local sector capital. A good lawyer could help the offender escape further punishment, however legal costs could potentially cost over 10,000 credits.<ref name="GG6" />

*'''Class Twos''', or Deuces, were for illegal transport for expensive goods and guns, especially if mounting them.<ref name="TEA" /> These offenses could result in the arrest of the crew, the impounding of the ship, a fine of at least 10,000 credits, and five to thirty years in prison.<ref name="GG6" /> Deuces could also be brought about by accusations of [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity, and in those cases, people would disappear and possibly be sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TEA" />

*'''Class Ones''', or Aces, were capital offenses that brought the harshest penalties. They would be for attacking other spacers, aggression against Imperial personnel, possessing a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], or harboring conspiracy to overthrow the Empire.<ref name="TEA" /> Those caught would likely be sentenced to five to thirty years for all involved on an Imperial penal colony, and even possibly death.<ref name="GG6" />
